## Description

Combines fractional cointegration testing with discrete wavelet transform multi-resolution analysis to isolate and trade persistent mean-reverting spread components across distinct frequency bands.

## Where it may fit

Persistent cointegrated asset pairs, noisy intraday statistical arbitrage, mixed-frequency spread trading.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency and daily price series of paired assets, wavelet filter coefficients.

## Caveats

Careful boundary padding is required in wavelet transforms to avoid look-ahead bias.
